piezas.titulo: Key words: common spellings and sounds

texto: Read frequent combinations and silent endings in familiar words. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.

Point to note: Ou, oi and au/eau have frequent correspondences; the pronunciation of ai varies depending on the word; many final consonants are silent, with exceptions. In this passage, «bonjour» means «hello».
